items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: Tom Brown or maybe you'd remember Nick Baraka.

ctx.x: No, I was living here two years. I lived on the Louisiana Avenue Annunciation before this. I lived on Sixth Street for quite some years. I don't know exactly how long. I lived there, Goodwire on the 16th Constance.
Well, he was a band leader. I thought maybe you'd remember him from there. I haven't danced to his music. Tom Brown or maybe you'd remember Nick Baraka.
He doesn't live too far from there. It seems to me like maybe it was Paul Barbra.
